import json, sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp/t')

AB = svc(('A',1),('B',2))          # columns [A,B]

def runjob(events, services=AB, limits=None):
    out = jrun({'jobs':[job(services, events, limits)]})
    return out['results'][0]['events']

def img(accept, rows): return {'accept':accept,'rows':rows}

      [dict(ok=True, epoch=1, image=img([False,True],[[1,D],[D,D]]))])
check('image match(A,B)', runjob([{'op':'stage','epoch':1,'policy':'match(A,B) allow;'}]),
      [dict(ok=True, epoch=1, image=img([False,False,True],[[1,D],[D,2],[D,D]]))])

      [dict(ok=True, epoch=1, image=img([True],[[0,0]]))])

      [dict(ok=True, epoch=1, image=img([False],[[D,D]]))])

      [dict(ok=True, epoch=1, image=img([False],[[D,D]]))])
